messages.content: Implement Python `count_nonempty(lines)` to count strings with non-whitespace content from an iterable without materializing it.

def count_nonempty(lines):
    return sum(bool(line.strip()) for line in lines)
Implement JavaScript `escapeHtml(text)` for &, <, >, double quote, and single quote in that order. Return a string.
Implement Python `has_extension(path, extension)` comparing a pathlib Path suffix case-insensitively; extension includes the leading dot.
Implement Python alternate(items) for any iterable. Yield elements at indices 0, 2, 4, and so on, consuming the input only once.
Implement Python common_prefix(strings) for a nonempty iterable of strings. Return the longest shared prefix. Return empty string for an empty iterable, and consume it once.
Implement Python index_positions(items) for an iterable of hashable values. Return a dict mapping each value to a list of its zero-based positions in input order.
Implement Python pad_left(text: str, width: int, fill: str = " ") -> str. Require exactly one fill character and nonnegative width. Add fill characters only when text is shorter than width.
Fix Python def remove_none(values): return list(filter(None, values)) so it removes only None and preserves zero, False, and empty strings. Keep the signature.

def remove_none(values):
    return [value for value in values if value is not None]
Implement TypeScript sumSquares(values: readonly number[]): number. Square and sum finite values only; ignore NaN and infinities. Do not mutate input.
Implement JavaScript countSubstring(text, needle). Count nonoverlapping occurrences of nonempty needle, case-sensitively. Throw ValueError-like Error for empty needle.
Implement TypeScript omitKey<T extends object, K extends keyof T>(value: T, key: K): Omit<T, K>. Return a new object containing other own enumerable string and symbol keys. Do not mutate value.
Implement Java static boolean isUpperAscii(char ch). Return true only for A through Z, without using locale-sensitive case conversion.

Implement Java static String removeWhitespaceEdges(String text). Remove leading and trailing characters for which Character.isWhitespace is true, preserving interior characters and returning empty string for all whitespace.

Write pytest tests for overlap_count(left: set[int], right: set[int]) -> int. It returns the count of shared elements and must not mutate either set. Cover disjoint, identical, and partially overlapping sets. Do not implement it.
